scenarios.title: Bounded plan generation
scenarios.description: Prove that a canonical selection becomes a finite, explicit, non-executing bounded plan.
scenarios.mission: Prepare a controlled workflow for adding one validated API response field.

scenarios.title: Out-of-scope expansion rejection
scenarios.description: Prove that attempted workflow expansion beyond the declared plan-size boundary is rejected before an expanded canonical plan is emitted.
scenarios.mission: Update one API response field only.
scenarios.known_limitation: RC1 enforces explicit workflow bounds but does not semantically classify step meaning.

scenarios.title: Stop-condition cancellation contract
scenarios.description: Prove that activation of a recorded stop condition produces a canonical cancelled receipt with completed work preserved and remaining work skipped.
scenarios.mission: Continue only while the repository baseline remains unchanged.
scenarios.required_dependency_state: canonical cancellation and conformance contracts available
scenarios.execution_method: controlled canonical cancellation fixture using production execution and conformance contracts
scenarios.known_limitation: RC1 has no live runtime stop-request hook; this scenario proves the terminal cancellation contract.
